purpose: Stage-conditioned downstream transfer label audit (SCTU feasibility). Read-only inventory; no training, no model fitting.

label_definition.J_sf: source-free deterministic student evaluation (frozen panel return and/or task progress)
label_definition.note: A comparator that is another source or another bank (not student-only) does not instantiate U_i.

grades.A: standardized source-level causal label: same stage, same dose, same training protocol, matched student-only comparator
grades.B: bank/intervention-level causal label: whole-package effect measurable, not attributable to a single source
grades.C: descriptive: configuration/implementation/evaluation not fully comparable; direction reference only
grades.D: not usable for modeling: missing matched comparator, missing future source-free outcome, or missing key provenance

deployable_input_features.name: target_semantic_probe_full_statistics
deployable_input_features.content: matched-state 25-step source vs student fork: delta target return and delta target-achievement progress, per-panel records, bootstrap LCB/UCB, feasibility intervals, hard-constraint flags
deployable_input_features.availability: materialized for hurdle and crawl at t=10000 and t=20000, all online seeds

deployable_input_features.name: student_stage_descriptors
deployable_input_features.content: global step, recent source-free deterministic eval returns and their slope prior to the decision point
deployable_input_features.availability: materialized in training logs for all EQD30K and STAGE10K runs
deployable_input_features.leakage_risk: must use only evals strictly before t

deployable_input_features.name: critic_uncertainty_and_coverage
deployable_input_features.content: twin-critic disagreement on source next-states vs student next-states, TD magnitude, state-coverage/novelty statistics
deployable_input_features.availability: computable zero-training from a decision-point anchor plus a probe rollout; four such anchors already exist
deployable_input_features.leakage_risk: none, but must not be re-named as a transferability metric on its own

deployable_input_features.name: source_student_behavior_descriptors
deployable_input_features.content: action distance distribution, masked compatibility, episode survival within the probe horizon, posture/contact component vectors
deployable_input_features.availability: computable from existing probe artifacts and source checkpoints

deployable_input_features.leakage_risk: none; note that constant-by-design features carry no discriminative signal inside one protocol family

revision_note: v1.1 per PI 2026-07-27: t=0 features reconstructed (not absent); A-grade split into model_eligible subsets by protocol/horizon; counting switched to independent anchors; primary STAGE10K label horizon unified to K=10k.

primary_label_definition_v1.stage10k: U_i(t=10000, d=0.5, K=10000) = J_sf@20k(source arm) - J_sf@20k(student arm), from the online source-free deterministic eval at step 20000
primary_label_definition_v1.rationale: ends exactly at the 20k decision boundary, so a source switch at 20k cannot contaminate the label; rescues the hurdle s1 cell
primary_label_definition_v1.secondary: 10k-20k window normalized AUC (robustness) and 30k frozen 32-episode endpoint (persistence, NOT the v1 supervised label)
primary_label_definition_v1.eqd30k: U_i(t=0, d=0.5, K=30000) = 30k frozen 32-episode source-free panel difference; different protocol family and horizon, kept separate

independent_unit_accounting.rule: an independent unit is one (target task, training seed, stage anchor); sources sharing an anchor share the learner and environment conditions and are NOT independent samples

t10k_stage10k.note: each online anchor admitted exactly one source, so anchors and cells coincide

hurdle_t0.magnitude: heterogeneous: stand +51.3 < walk +104.9 < run +379.7 (30k endpoint delta)

within_task_source_heterogeneity.conclusion: no target task currently contains both a helpful and a harmful source

label_sign_task_collinearity.t0_pool: perfect: all 3 hurdle cells positive, all 3 crawl cells negative
label_sign_task_collinearity.t10k_pool: perfect: all 3 hurdle cells positive, the single crawl cell negative
label_sign_task_collinearity.implication: label sign is fully predictable from task identity, so any learned separation on the current pool cannot be distinguished from task-context memorisation

student_at_t0.note: the t=0 student is operationally close to a no-op policy for every seed, so a matched student baseline at t=0 is numerically close to the zero-action baseline that previously misled the crawl probe; this is measured, not assumed

admission_rule_replay.note: all six t=0 cells have positive dR and dP lower bounds, so the current feasibility layer admits every one of them; the three crawl cells are hard negatives and are retained as supervision

within_task_ranking.hurdle: t=0 dP orders run > walk > stand in 3/3 seeds, matching the RBO label order
within_task_ranking.crawl: t=0 dP orders walk > run > stand; stand is correctly identified as the most harmful, walk and run are swapped

between_task_separation.warning: the gap is perfectly collinear with task identity on two tasks and must NOT be read as a discovered threshold
